title: Sordland/Turn08/A_LiviaPetrGone
description: Press asking questions about Petr/Livia's disappearance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It had been several days since I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser detain Livia and Petr. Word was about to get out that both the vice president and the president's secretary were in jail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It had been several days since I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly arrest Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It had been several days since I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly kill Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At Lucian's urging, I had arranged..."
entries.dialogueText: At Lucian's urging, I had arranged a press conference to get ahead of the narrative.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Of course, our deal with Marcel Kor..."
entries.dialogueText: Of course, our deal with Marcel Koronti meant journalists wouldn't be asking too many questions. Still, one had to keep up appearances.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was still reeling from the loss o..."
entries.dialogueText: I was still reeling from the loss of two of my closest colleagues -- and my former best friend. I had to get my story straight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The conference was slated to begin..."
entries.dialogueText: The conference was slated to begin soon. I rang up Karl.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Yes, Mr. President?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're positive the bodies won't b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're positive the bodies won't be found?"
entries.menuText: "You're positive the bodies won't be found?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How exactly did you dispose of Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "How exactly did you dispose of Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno?"
entries.menuText: "How exactly did you dispose of Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno being held?"
entries.menuText: "Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno being held?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno holding up in detention?"
entries.menuText: "How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno holding up in detention?"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""In individual cells on the top flo..."
entries.dialogueText: "In individual cells on the top floor of Antel Rock, sir. Accessible by two guards, each of whom know only half of the combination required to enter."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Mr. Vectern is still quite shaken,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern is still quite shaken, sir. Miss Suno appears calmer, although she continues to ask for a lawyer."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""They've both been dissolved in an..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've both been dissolved in an extremely powerful acidic solution, sir. No trace has been left."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good work.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good work."
entries.menuText: "Good work."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's disgusting.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's disgusting."
entries.menuText: "That's disgusting."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""My men and I do what we must to se..."
entries.dialogueText: "My men and I do what we must to serve Sordland, sir."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""It's my pleasure, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's my pleasure, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. Let them both rot.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Let them both rot."
entries.menuText: "Good. Let them both rot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell the guards Petr can have a li..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell the guards Petr can have a little steak once in a while. As a treat."
entries.menuText: "Tell the guards Petr can have a little steak once in a while. As a treat."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""I will, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will, sir."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""Pleasure to serve you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pleasure to serve you, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moment I hung up. Lucian knocke..."
entries.dialogueText: The moment I hung up. Lucian knocked on my door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was late in the afternoon, and I..."
entries.dialogueText: It was late in the afternoon, and I was nervously pacing around my office. My new secretary would start next week.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's time, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's time, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and I made our way to the downst..."
entries.dialogueText: He and I made our way to the downstairs conference room. A dozen journalists were already waiting, notepads at the ready. They all stood up when we entered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good afternoon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon."
entries.menuText: "Good afternoon."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please be seated.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please be seated."
entries.menuText: "Please be seated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for coming.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for coming."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The journalists started talking. I..."
entries.dialogueText: The journalists started talking. I motioned for quiet.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured that both offenders h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that both offenders have been dealt with."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured that both offenders have been dealt with."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unfortunately, before they could b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, before they could be punished for their misdeeds, both disappeared. It is assumed that they ran away together."
entries.menuText: "Unfortunately, before they could be punished for their misdeeds, both disappeared. It is assumed that they ran away together."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured that the offenders ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that the offenders have now been imprisoned."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured that the offenders have now been imprisoned."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am currently reviewing highly qu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am currently reviewing highly qualified candidates for both positions."
entries.menuText: "I am currently reviewing highly qualified candidates for both positions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This incident shall not interfere..."
entries.dialogueText: "This incident shall not interfere with the completion of my presidential goals."
entries.menuText: "This incident shall not interfere with the completion of my presidential goals."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The rest of my staff is now under..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rest of my staff is now under investigation to root out any other potential wrongdoing."
entries.menuText: "The rest of my staff is now under investigation to root out any other potential wrongdoing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By now the reporters were nearly ju..."
entries.dialogueText: By now the reporters were nearly jumping out of their seats, hands raised.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Please be aware that the president..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please be aware that the president only has time to answer a limited number of questions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the reporter at the..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the reporter at the far end of the table.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Both offenders have now been fired.""
entries.dialogueText: "Both offenders have now been fired."
entries.menuText: "Both offenders have now been fired."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, how are you persona..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, how are you personally coping with this horrifying betrayal? It must be very hard on top of all the other stress you have to face in office."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I said a silent prayer of thanks to..."
entries.dialogueText: I said a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not very well, to be honest. But t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not very well, to be honest. But the pain will pass in time."
entries.menuText: "Not very well, to be honest. But the pain will pass in time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't have time to dwell on it...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have time to dwell on it. I must move forward so I can continue to do the same with Sordland."
entries.menuText: "I don't have time to dwell on it. I must move forward so I can continue to do the same with Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""About as well as can be expected...."
entries.dialogueText: "About as well as can be expected. I'm looking forward to having this all behind me."
entries.menuText: "About as well as can be expected. I'm looking forward to having this all behind me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and the other reporters nodded."
entries.dialogueText: She and the other reporters nodded.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""I see, Mr. President. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see, Mr. President. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I would like to address the growin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to address the growing rumors concerning Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."
entries.menuText: "I would like to address the growing rumors concerning Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am here to address an incident i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am here to address an incident involving Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."
entries.menuText: "I am here to address an incident involving Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unbeknownst to me and the rest of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unbeknownst to me and the rest of the administration, these two employees were carrying on a lurid affair in flagrant defiance of Sordish values."
entries.menuText: "Unbeknownst to me and the rest of the administration, these two employees were carrying on a lurid affair in flagrant defiance of Sordish values."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unbeknownst to my administration,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unbeknownst to my administration, these two employees were plotting a conspiracy to remove me from office."
entries.menuText: "Unbeknownst to my administration, these two employees were plotting a conspiracy to remove me from office."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, wouldn't you agree..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, wouldn't you agree that imprisonment is a rather harsh sentence for a simple affair?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, can either Miss Sun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, can either Miss Suno or Mr. Vectern be reached for comment about this incident?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President... what exactly do y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President... what exactly do you mean by 'dealt with'?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, what evidence of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, what evidence of this conspiracy do you have that would warrant imprisonment?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, are you attempting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, are you attempting to track the co-conspirators down?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President, do you have any ide..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, do you have any idea where Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno could have gone?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, we've got our best men on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we've got our best men on the case."
entries.menuText: "Yes, we've got our best men on the case."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unfortunately, they covered their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, they covered their tracks too well."
entries.menuText: "Unfortunately, they covered their tracks too well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The state is under attack, and you..."
entries.dialogueText: "The state is under attack, and you're asking about evidence?"
entries.menuText: "The state is under attack, and you're asking about evidence?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I cannot disclose the evidence at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot disclose the evidence at this time."
entries.menuText: "I cannot disclose the evidence at this time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They've gotten what they deserve.""
entries.dialogueText: "They've gotten what they deserve."
entries.menuText: "They've gotten what they deserve."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Both have expressed a refusal to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both have expressed a refusal to speak to the media."
entries.menuText: "Both have expressed a refusal to speak to the media."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The state has exercised its discre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The state has exercised its discretion as to the appropriate punishment."
entries.menuText: "The state has exercised its discretion as to the appropriate punishment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Both are currently taking some tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both are currently taking some time away from Holsord to reflect on their misbehavior."
entries.menuText: "Both are currently taking some time away from Holsord to reflect on their misbehavior."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our values are under attack, and y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our values are under attack, and you're asking whether prison is too harsh?"
entries.menuText: "Our values are under attack, and you're asking whether prison is too harsh?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not for such high-ranking official..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not for such high-ranking officials, no."
entries.menuText: "Not for such high-ranking officials, no."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. They covered their tracks too..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. They covered their tracks too well."
entries.menuText: "No. They covered their tracks too well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Possibly the border. We've got our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Possibly the border. We've got our best men on the case."
entries.menuText: "Possibly the border. We've got our best men on the case."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""And exactly how long will the sent..."
entries.dialogueText: "And exactly how long will the sentence be?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""And where exactly are they located..."
entries.dialogueText: "And where exactly are they located right now?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""And what evidence do you have of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what evidence do you have of this so-called conspiracy?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""You haven't answered my question.""
entries.dialogueText: "You haven't answered my question."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""And were you aware of the multiple..."
entries.dialogueText: "And were you aware of the multiple affairs Mr. Vectern is rumored to have previously conducted?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No further questions.""
entries.dialogueText: "No further questions."
entries.menuText: "No further questions."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured to Lucian."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to Lucian.
entries.menuText: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""But--""
entries.dialogueText: "But--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian smoothly interjected."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian smoothly interjected.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you for your time, ladies an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your time, ladies and gentlemen. That will be all for today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reporters reluctantly left the..."
entries.dialogueText: The reporters reluctantly left the conference room, leaving Lucian and myself alone.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That went well.""
entries.dialogueText: "That went well."
entries.menuText: "That went well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So? Am I screwed?""
entries.dialogueText: "So? Am I screwed?"
entries.menuText: "So? Am I screwed?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Marcel Koronti has come through fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marcel Koronti has come through for us yet again. I'm not sure how much longer we can count on his kindness."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The press may have been left with..."
entries.dialogueText: "The press may have been left with some dangling questions. But if Mr. Greiser did his job correctly, they'll never find the answers."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very funny, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very funny, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very good, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well. We shall discuss it tom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. We shall discuss it tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Too soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Too soon."
entries.menuText: "Too soon."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're a little old to be my secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."
entries.menuText: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In the meantime, sir, there's the..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, sir, there's the matter of replacing both your secretary and your vice president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have a few candidates in mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have a few candidates in mind."
entries.menuText: "I have a few candidates in mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the conference room. On the..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the conference room. On the long walk back to my office, I started to think about who my new vice president should be.
